instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: MediSolve is a medium-sized healthtech firm specializing in AI-driven diagnostic tools for chronic disease management. The company operates in a highly regulated environment due to FDA compliance requirements, necessitating rigorous testing and adherence to evolving privacy laws.
answers.pastInitiatives: They have successfully launched two software prototypes addressing specific clinical pain points but struggle with scaling the technology into commercial products. Recent efforts focus on streamlining internal R&D cycles.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is aggressive market penetration in North America within three years by securing major partnerships and expanding the service portfolio. We aim to capture a significant share of the mid-market diagnostic testing segment.
answers.teamSize: The core innovation team consists of 6 highly skilled engineers and clinical advisors, supported by a small operations staff. Talent retention remains a key focus.
answers.additionalContext: Competitors are rapidly integrating similar AI diagnostics into hospital systems, requiring MediSolve to maintain a strong pipeline of innovative products.

opportunities.title: Automated Clinical Data Pipeline Integration
opportunities.rationale: Implementing standardized data pipelines will significantly reduce the time required for internal clinical validation and regulatory submission preparation. This addresses current process bottlenecks without requiring massive R&D expenditure.

first_actions: Select and pilot a low-cost cloud data integration platform (e.g., AWS/Azure service).
Create a dedicated 'Data Compliance' working group.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average time from prototype validation to submission readiness by 30%.
milestones: Q1: Platform selection and sandbox environment setup.
Q2: Integration of one legacy data source for pilot testing.

opportunities.title: Developing a Personalized Preventative Health Model (GenAI)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging cutting-edge Generative AI to create truly personalized treatment recommendations based on individual genetic and lifestyle data could position the company as a market leader. This is high risk but offers massive growth potential.

first_actions: Allocate $50k for external PhD consultant consultation.
Establish a dedicated R&D sprint team.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% adoption rate among pilot clinical partners.
milestones: Q3: Proof-of-concept model trained on proprietary data.
Q4: Internal beta testing and regulatory pathway feasibility assessment.

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional task force to evaluate the regulatory impact of cloud data solutions.
Define KPIs for the personalized health model and secure external seed funding.
Standardize internal process documentation to improve operational efficiency.

key_weaknesses: Slow internal innovation pipeline for new product types.
High dependency on a single core technical team member (talent risk).
Lack of established formal partnership scaling process.
Limited experience navigating complex international regulatory compliance.
